facts.fact: The Ministry of Public Health's PNDS III states that all the SNIS paper forms and reports are digitised in the 11 health directorates within the DHIS2 platform, introduced from 2011; no date is given for the statement, so the document's June 2023 date is used.

PNDS III says the Strategic Plan for the Health Information System (PENSIS 2022-2026) is the second strategic plan for this area produced in Guinea-Bissau, and that the plan recognises constraints in the SNIS's main routine flow and in its subsystems.
facts.system: Sistema Nacional de Informação em Saúde (SNIS)

facts.fact: PNDS III places the SNIS under INASA in its account of the health system and says each of the 11 health regions has an officer responsible for the Health Information System attached to the region; it adds that a single repository managed by the SNIS Directorate, answering to INASA's president and the minister, is still lacking. Undated in the text, so the document's June 2023 date is used.
facts.system: Sistema Nacional de Informação em Saúde (SNIS)

facts.fact: PNDS III reports that at the private Clínica Madrugada in Bissau an electronic patient record application has been developed since 2017 and is replacing all paper forms and reports in the staff's daily clinical, diagnostic, therapeutic and follow-up work; the plan cites it as the one positive case, in the private sector.
facts.system: Registo Eletrónico do Doente, Clínica Madrugada
